info.title: GovCon Supply Chain SCRM, NDAA 889, TAA & SBOM Auditor API
info.description: Audits hardware Bills of Materials (BOMs), sub-tier suppliers, and Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) against NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 C-SCRM, FAR 52.204-25 (NDAA Section 889 Part A/B covered telecommunications & video surveillance), FAR 52.204-30 (FASCSA exclusion orders), the Buy American Act (FAR Part 25), and the Trade Agreements Act (FAR 52.225-5) to return a 0-100 supply chain risk score, per-line NDAA 889 / TAA determinations, BAA domestic-content analysis, NIST 800-161 control gaps, NTIA SBOM & CISA Secure Software Self-Attestation readiness, paste-ready C-SCRM Plan sections, and a SCRM POA&M remediation roadmap. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Audit Supply Chain SCRM, NDAA 889, TAA And SBOM
post.description: Screens every BOM line for NDAA Section 889 covered equipment (Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision, Dahua and affiliates), FASCSA exclusions, TAA designated-country and Buy American domestic-content compliance, reviews SBOM components for NTIA minimum elements, CISA KEV vulnerabilities and license risk, and generates a NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 C-SCRM Plan with a prioritized POA&M and proposal narrative.

solicitation_or_contract_context.description: Solicitation / contract scope, Section H/I supply chain clauses, delivery location, end-use, and any agency C-SCRM, NDAA 889, TAA, BAA, or SBOM requirements.

offeror_name.description: Legal name of the prime offeror / reseller submitting the BOM and representations.

contracting_agency.description: Contracting agency or SLED buyer (e.g., 'U.S. Army PEO C3T', 'GSA FAS', 'Arizona ADOA-ASET').

applicable_contract_clauses.description: Supply chain clauses/standards in the solicitation (e.g., 'FAR 52.204-25', 'FAR 52.204-30', 'FAR 52.225-5', 'DFARS 252.225-7001', 'DFARS 252.204-7012', 'DFARS 252.246-7008', 'NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1', 'OMB M-22-18').

bom_line_items.description: Hardware / COTS Bill of Materials line items with part number, manufacturer, country of origin, and supplier tier (1 to 200 lines).

line_item_id.description: Unique BOM / CLIN / quote line identifier (e.g., 'CLIN 0001', 'BOM-003').

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number (MPN), SKU, or NSN of the item (e.g., 'DS-2CD2143G2-I', 'C9300-48P-E').

description.description: Short item description (e.g., '4MP IP Dome Camera', '48-Port PoE+ Access Switch').

manufacturer.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) brand/legal entity (screened against NDAA 889 covered entities and known affiliates/white-label OEMs).

country_of_origin.description: Country of origin / country of substantial transformation (ISO 3166 alpha-2 code or country name, e.g., 'US', 'Mexico', 'China', 'Taiwan').

supplier_name.description: Reseller, distributor, or sub-tier supplier furnishing this item (blank if purchased direct from the OEM).

supplier_tier.description: Supply chain tier of the furnishing supplier relative to the prime offeror.

item_category.description: Item category used to route NDAA 889, FASCSA, TAA, BAA (COTS IT exception), and DFARS 252.246-7008 counterfeit-parts logic.

quantity.description: Quantity of units on this line.

unit_cost_usd.description: Unit price in USD (used for TAA thresholds and BAA domestic-content weighting).

domestic_component_cost_pct.description: Optional known percentage (0-100) of component cost that is US-domestic for this line (FAR 25.101 domestic content test). Leave null if unknown.
domestic_component_cost_pct.title: Domestic Component Cost Pct

software_components.description: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) components (name, version, purl, SPDX license, supplier, known CVEs) for NTIA minimum-elements and CISA secure software attestation review (0 to 500 components).

purl.description: Package URL (purl) unique identifier (e.g., 'pkg:maven/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core@2.17.1'). Blank if unknown.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g., 'Apache-2.0', 'MIT', 'GPL-3.0-only'). Blank if unknown.

supplier.description: Component supplier / author / maintainer organization (NTIA minimum element 'Supplier Name'). Blank if unknown.

known_vulnerabilities.description: Known CVE / GHSA identifiers or CISA KEV entries affecting this component version (e.g., ['CVE-2021-44228']).

sbom_format.description: Format of the offeror's SBOM deliverable ('CycloneDX_1_6' default, 'SPDX_2_3', 'SPDX_3_0', 'Proprietary_Or_Spreadsheet', or 'None_Available').

target_compliance_regime.description: Target supply chain regulatory regime ('Auto_Detect_From_Clauses' default, 'Federal_DoD_Full_C_SCRM_NDAA_889_TAA_BAA', 'Federal_Civilian_FASCSA_And_CISA_Secure_Software', or 'State_SLED_Prohibited_Vendor_And_Domestic_Preference').

additional_supplier_notes.description: Optional sub-tier supplier attestations, SAM.gov FAR 52.204-24/26 representations, ownership/affiliation notes, or existing C-SCRM program documentation.

example.solicitation_or_contract_context: Arizona ADOA-ASET Statewide Network Refresh & Public Safety Video Surveillance RFP (Arizona APP / Procure.AZ.gov). Scope: furnish and install 48-port PoE+ access switches, 4MP IP dome cameras, and a cloud video management platform for 12 ADOT and DPS facilities. Section H requires offerors to certify FAR 52.204-25 (NDAA Section 889) compliance for federally funded (DHS/FEMA grant) line items, Trade Agreements Act designated-country end products, NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 C-SCRM practices, and delivery of a CycloneDX SBOM for all software/firmware.
